_schema.note: Gameplay boss definitions. Combat stats live with the enemy definitions in data/enemies/enemies.json (bosses are spawned through the same pool); this file carries encounter scripting, presentation and the phase table the HUD and codex read.
_schema.controller: Script that drives the encounter. 'saparata' is implemented by scripts/bosses/saparata_encounter.gd.

bosses.name: Saparata
bosses.title: Leader of Cindercrest · Second King of Unstable
bosses.intro_line: You gave the server to the new players, Parrot. I'm taking it back.
bosses.defeat_line: History says this fort fell. Today it didn't.

phases.name: Cindercrest Vanguard
phases.basis: Cindercrest's ground assault on Fort Feather, which the fort initially repelled.
phases.mechanic: Dense netherite waves; Saparata is not yet on the field.

phases.name: Elite Strike
phases.basis: ShoeBilly's assassinations at Skymore and his mace fighting at Merchant City and Steampunk City.
phases.mechanic: Mini-boss ShoeBilly stuns towers he passes; his helmet breaks at half health and he speeds up.

phases.name: The Redstone Blimp
phases.basis: The Redstone Blimp that dropped slow-falling paratroopers into Fort Feather.
phases.mechanic: A destructible blimp crosses the map dropping paratroopers deep in the path; shooting it down ends the drops.

phases.name: Saparata Enters
phases.desc: The King of Unstable takes the field.
phases.basis: Saparata personally confronting King ParrotX2 at the Battle for Capital City.
phases.mechanic: Ember Strike stuns the nearest tower every 6 seconds; Revanchist Call heals him while his soldiers are near. Transitions at 50% health.

phases.name: The Usurper King
phases.desc: He turns your own army against you.
phases.basis: Persuading Parrot's Royal Army to defect, and crowning himself King.
phases.mechanic: Persuasion turns one tower against you for 5 seconds; Royal Defectors join the waves; below 25% health Old Players' Wrath grants speed and armor.

bosses.name: ShoeBilly_
bosses.title: The Assassin of Skymore
bosses.intro_line: Nine hundred and ninety-nine. One expedition at a time.
bosses.defeat_line: His armour broke. He'll be back.

phases.name: Full Netherite
phases.basis: ShoeBilly as a renowned assassin and talented mace player.
phases.mechanic: Sabotage stuns towers he passes; regenerates while unharmed.

phases.name: Helmet Broken
phases.basis: Wemmbu trapped him in webs and broke his helmet with stab shots at Steampunk City.
phases.mechanic: Loses the helmet tier: less armor, more speed.
